name: @venizia/vulcan-workspace
description: VULCAN - the agentic-coding toolkit and the single source of truth for knowledge, agent and atlas tooling across VENIZIA projects.

scripts.prepare: if [ -f node_modules/.bin/vulcan ]; then bun node_modules/.bin/vulcan project sync --quiet < /dev/null || echo 'vulcan: sync did not finish: if the config is in the flat shape run bun node_modules/.bin/vulcan config codemod config-groups . --write, else run bun node_modules/.bin/vulcan project sync'; else echo 'vulcan: not installed yet: run bun install'; fi; exit 0
